simple.meaning: תִּשְׁעִים (tishʻîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “ninety.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 20 times across Genesis, 1 Samuel, 1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 5:9. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תִּשְׁעִים (H8673).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: תִּשְׁעִים (tishʻîym) / H8673 is traced through Genesis 5:9, Genesis 5:17, Genesis 5:30, Genesis 17:1 as a generated source-based concept entry.

BIBLICAL ARAMAIC [ Dan 2:4-7 :28 2:4 b-7:28; Ezra 4:8-6:18; Ezra 7:12-26 ; Jer 10:11 ; Gen 31:47 a β . ] NOTE. - In the case of words common to Biblical Aramaic and Biblical Hebrew the etymological matter already given with the Hebrew words is not repeated here. The sign is prefixed to all words peculiar to the Biblical Aramaic. In other cases, except where ᵑ7 or Syriac is mentioned alone, it may be understood that the words occur also in the Aramaic of the ᵑ7 s and in Syriac, even when this is not expressly stated.

occurrences.englishText: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.
All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.
Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.
Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”
Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.
Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.
The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.
All the temple servants, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

The children of the captivity, who had come out of exile, offered burnt offerings to the God of Israel, twelve bulls for all Israel, ninety-six rams, seventy-seven lambs, and twelve male goats for a sin offering. All this was a burnt offering to Yahweh.
The children of Ater: of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
The children of Gibeon: ninety-five.
All the temple servants and the children of Solomon’s servants were three hundred ninety-two.
There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.
For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.

“Take for yourself also wheat, barley, beans, lentils, millet, and spelt, and put them in one vessel. Make bread of it. According to the number of the days that you will lie on your side, even three hundred ninety days, you shall eat of it.
The building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits wide; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick all around, and its length ninety cubits.
“From the time that the continual burnt offering is taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
